attribute.enum_value_number_required: A numeric enum value is required when the data type is number and the attribute is an enum
attribute.enum_value_text_required: A text enum value is required when the data type is text and the attribute is an enum
attribute_value.value_mismatch: The value type does not match the attribute's data type
attribute_value.value_required: A value is required for this attribute type
brand.has_templates: This brand is still used by products
field_desc.inventory_brand.country_id: The country the brand comes from.
The record the event is about, usually a stock reservation.
How many times sending the event has been tried. A high number means the event is stuck.
Unique identifier of the event. Receiving systems use it to recognise and ignore an event delivered twice.
What happened, e.g. InventoryReservationCreated or InventoryReservationConsumed.
Why the last attempt to send the event failed.
When the business event happened, which can be earlier than when it was sent.
The event's details, recorded as they were when it happened. They never change afterwards.

Version of the event's data format, such as 1.0, so receiving systems know how to read it.
field_desc.inventory_location.barcode: Barcode printed on the location's label, scanned to identify the location.
field_desc.inventory_location.canonical_: Full name of the location, made of the names from the top-level location down to this one, e.g. MAIN / Zone A / Shelf 1. Updated automatically.
field_desc.inventory_location.hierarchy_: How many levels below the top-level location this location sits; 0 for a top-level location. Updated automatically.
field_desc.inventory_location.is_repleni: The location may receive replenishment, i.e. stock transferred in to refill it.
field_desc.inventory_location.is_system_: Set on locations the warehouse creates automatically, such as its stock and receiving locations. They cannot be moved or archived on their own.
field_desc.inventory_location.location_t:
The kind of place this location represents. Only internal locations hold the company's own stock; group locations only organise others and hold none; the other kinds are the opposite side of stock movements.
* Internal (Physical): a physical place that holds the company's stock
* Group (Virtual): a location that only groups others, such as a warehouse's root; it holds no stock
* Customer (Virtual): where goods go when delivered to customers
* Vendor (Virtual): where goods come from when received from suppliers
* Inventory Loss (Virtual): where stock found missing or damaged during counts is recorded
* Production (Virtual): where components are consumed and finished goods come from in production
* Scrap (Virtual): where damaged or unusable goods are moved
* In transit (Virtual): goods on their way between steps or between warehouses
field_desc.inventory_location.parent_loc: The location this one sits inside, which also decides its warehouse. Empty for a top-level location.
field_desc.inventory_location.removal_st:
The order in which goods are taken out of this location and its sub-locations.
* First in, first out: first in, first out: the oldest goods leave first
* Last in, first out: last in, first out: the newest goods leave first
* First to expire, first out: first expired, first out: the goods expiring soonest leave first
* Closest location: goods in the closest location are taken first
* Fewest packages: the fewest packages needed to cover the quantity are taken
field_desc.inventory_location.storage_ca: Storage category that sets the location's capacity and which goods may be kept together in it. Only relevant for locations that hold goods.
field_desc.inventory_location.warehouse_: The warehouse this location belongs to. It is filled in automatically from the parent location, and is empty for locations outside any warehouse, such as vendor or customer locations.
field_desc.inventory_product_attribute.c: Whether the variant creation mode can still be changed: the attribute is not archived and no product uses it.
Number of products currently using this attribute, archived ones included. While it is above zero, the variant creation mode cannot be changed.
field_desc.inventory_product_attribute.d:
The kind of values the attribute takes. Only option attributes can create product variants.
* Option: a choice from a list of values
* Text: free text
* Number: a number
* Date: a date
* Yes / No: yes or no

How the attribute's values are shown for selection. It only affects display.
* Pills: buttons shown side by side
* Radio buttons: radio buttons
* Drop-down: a drop-down list
* Colour swatch: colour swatches, using each value's colour
* Multiple checkboxes: checkboxes allowing several values at once; only for attributes that never create variants
field_desc.inventory_product_attribute.h: Number of products that used this attribute in the past and then removed it. Such an attribute can no longer be deleted.
field_desc.inventory_product_attribute.v:
When product variants are created from this attribute's values.
* Instant: every combination is created as soon as values are assigned to a product
* When ordered: a variant is created only when its combination is actually used, e.g. in an order
* Never: no variants are created; the chosen value is only recorded on the order
field_desc.inventory_product_attribute_v: The attribute this value belongs to. It cannot be moved to another attribute.
Colour of the swatch, as #RRGGBB, shown when the attribute is displayed as colours.
No longer used for pricing. Price extras are now set per product, on the product's attribute values.
Display order of the value within its attribute.
field_desc.inventory_product_category.ca: Full name of the category, made of the names from the root down to this one, e.g. Default / Beverages / Soft drinks. Updated automatically.
field_desc.inventory_product_category.di: Display order among categories with the same parent.
field_desc.inventory_product_category.ex: The record's identifier in its source system, used to recognise the record when it is imported again.
field_desc.inventory_product_category.is: Marks the organization's root category, Default, under which all other categories sit.
field_desc.inventory_product_category.pa: The category this one sits under. A category created without a parent is placed under the root category.
field_desc.inventory_product_category.so: Where the record comes from: manual for records entered by hand, import for records loaded from a file, or the code of an external system.
field_desc.inventory_product_template.at: The product's attributes, their selected values and the value combinations excluded; together they decide the variants.
field_desc.inventory_product_template.ba: The product's reference selling price, before any price list or discount. The price on an order may differ.
field_desc.inventory_product_template.br: The brand the product is sold under.
field_desc.inventory_product_template.ca: The product category used to group and report on products.
field_desc.inventory_product_template.de: Height used for variants that do not have their own.
Length used for variants that do not have their own.
Weight used for variants that do not have their own.
Width used for variants that do not have their own.
field_desc.inventory_product_template.ex: The record's identifier in its source system, used to recognise the record when it is imported again.
field_desc.inventory_product_template.is: Marks a bundle of products sold as one product. Stock tracking still follows the product type.
field_desc.inventory_product_template.ma: The highest cost among the product's variants. Equal to the lowest cost when all variants cost the same.
field_desc.inventory_product_template.mi: The lowest cost among the product's variants. Empty when the product has no variants.
field_desc.inventory_product_template.pr: Main image of the product. Variants without an image of their own show this one.

How the product is handled. Only goods are tracked in stock.
* Goods: a physical product whose stock is tracked
* Service: a service, never tracked in stock
field_desc.inventory_product_template.pu: Description shown to vendors on purchase documents.
Whether the product can be purchased.
field_desc.inventory_product_template.sa: Whether the product can be sold.
Description shown to customers on sales documents.
field_desc.inventory_product_template.sh: A shorter name used where space is limited, such as on receipts or kiosk screens.
field_desc.inventory_product_template.so: Where the record comes from: manual for records entered by hand, import for records loaded from a file, or the code of an external system.
field_desc.inventory_product_template.uo: Unit the product is counted and sold in.
Name of the product's unit of measure.
field_desc.inventory_product_template.va: Number of active (not archived) variants of the product.
field_desc.inventory_product_template_at: Counts the times the attribute has been applied to the product. Adding a removed attribute again starts a new revision.
The attribute applied to the product. The values the product allows are chosen on this line.
Off once the attribute has been removed from the product. The line is kept because existing variants still use its values.
The product this attribute line belongs to.
Display order of the attribute on this product, which can differ from the attribute's own order.

The attribute's variant creation mode when it was applied to the product, kept to explain the variants it created.
* Instant: every combination is created as soon as values are assigned to a product
* When ordered: a variant is created only when its combination is actually used, e.g. in an order
* Never: no variants are created; the chosen value is only recorded on the order
An attribute value allowed for this product. Each product can allow its own subset of an attribute's values.
Off once the value has been unselected on the product. It is kept because existing variants still use it.
Amount added to the product's base sales price when this value is chosen. It can be negative.
Display order of the value on this product.
The product's attribute line this value belongs to.
field_desc.inventory_product_template_co: One of two attribute values that cannot be combined in a variant of this product.
The product this exclusion applies to.
The other attribute value that cannot be combined with the first one.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.arc:
Why the variant was archived. Restoring a product restores only the variants archived together with it.
* Archived by a user: archived by a user
* Archived with its template: archived because its product was archived
* Archived by synchronization: archived by a system synchronisation
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.att: The variant's attributes and their values.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.ava: Quantity on hand minus quantity reserved.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.bas: For a product that mixes instant and dynamic attributes, the base variant this variant was created from.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.com: Identifies the variant's combination of attribute values. Empty for a product without variants.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.cos: What the variant costs the business per unit, used for margins and stock valuation. It is not the vendor's price.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.dis: Name of the variant as shown to people: the product name followed by its attribute values, e.g. Coca Cola (No sugar, Big).
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.eff: The variant's base selling price: the product's base sales price plus its attribute price extras. Price lists start from this price.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.ext: The record's identifier in its source system, used to recognise the record when it is imported again.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.hei: Height of the variant. When empty, the product's default height applies.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.is_: Whether the variant can be used in sales, purchases and stock movements: it is complete, active and not archived, and its product is neither archived nor discontinued.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.len: Length of the variant. When empty, the product's default length applies.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.on_: Total quantity physically in stock across all locations.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.pre: The variant's own image. When empty, the product's image is shown.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.pri: Barcode that identifies this variant when scanned, unique within the organization.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.pro: Base sales price of the variant's product, before the variant's price extras.
The product this variant belongs to. It cannot be changed.
Whether the variant's product is archived.
Whether the variant's product is a bundle sold as one product.
Image of the variant's product, shown when the variant has no image of its own.

Type of the variant's product. Only goods are tracked in stock.
* Goods: a physical product whose stock is tracked
* Service: a service, never tracked in stock
Purchase description of the variant's product.
Whether the variant's product can be purchased.
Whether the variant's product can be sold.
Sales description of the variant's product.
Short name of the variant's product.

Lifecycle status of the variant's product, separate from the variant's own status.
* Draft: being prepared, not yet in use
* Active: in use
* Discontinued: no longer offered; it can no longer be used in new transactions
Unit of measure of the variant's product.
Name of the unit of measure of the variant's product.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.res: Total quantity reserved for outgoing movements across all locations.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.sal: Total amount the variant's attribute values add to the product's base sales price.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.sku: Internal reference of the variant, unique within the organization.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.sou: Where the record comes from: manual for records entered by hand, import for records loaded from a file, or the code of an external system.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.var:
The role of the variant.
* Base: an internal anchor for products that mix instant and dynamic attributes; it is never sold or stocked
* Complete: a variant that can be sold and stocked, built from all variant-creating attributes
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.wei: Weight of the variant. When empty, the product's default weight applies.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant.wid: Width of the variant. When empty, the product's default width applies.
field_desc.inventory_product_variant_att: The variant this attribute value belongs to.
Amount this value adds to the variant's price, copied from the product's attribute value.
The attribute value, among those the product allows, that the variant is built from.
field_desc.inventory_putaway_rule.destin: Where the goods should be put. It must be in the same warehouse as the arrival location.
field_desc.inventory_putaway_rule.packag: Limits the rule to one package type. Optional.
field_desc.inventory_putaway_rule.priori: Order in which matching rules are tried; lower numbers first. The first suitable rule wins.
field_desc.inventory_putaway_rule.produc: Limits the rule to products of this category. Optional.
Limits the rule to one product. Optional.
field_desc.inventory_putaway_rule.source: Where goods arrive for this rule to apply. The rule only suggests where to put them; it never moves goods.
field_desc.inventory_putaway_rule.storag: Limits the rule to destinations of this storage category. Optional.
field_desc.inventory_putaway_rule.subloc:
How a sub-location under the destination is chosen.
* Fixed: always the destination itself
* Last used: the sub-location used most recently
* By storage category: any sub-location matching the storage category
field_desc.inventory_putaway_rule.wareho: The warehouse the rule applies in.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move.base_dem: Demanded quantity converted to the product's base unit.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move.currency: Currency of the move's values. Not filled in yet.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move.deadline: Latest time by which the move should be done.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move.demand_q: Quantity requested by the move. It is kept even when only part is processed; the rest goes to a backorder.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move.destinat: Where the goods are moved to.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move.final_lo: Where the goods end up at the end of a multi-step flow, when the destination is only an intermediate step.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move.is_inven: Marks a move created by a stock count rather than by a transfer.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move.origin_m: The move this one was split from, or the previous step in a multi-step flow.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move.picked: Whether the goods have been physically picked.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move.priority: Higher values are handled first when stock is scarce.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move.remainin: Quantity of this incoming move not yet used by outgoing moves, for FIFO stock valuation. Not filled in yet.
Value of the remaining quantity, for stock valuation. Not filled in yet.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move.reservat: When the move becomes eligible for automatic reservation, when stock is reserved before the scheduled date.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move.schedule: When the move is planned to happen.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move.scrap_id: The scrap document that created this move.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move.source_i: The line of the requesting document this move serves, such as a sales fulfillment item.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move.source_l: Where the goods are moved from.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move.transfer: The transfer this move belongs to. Empty for moves made by the system, such as inventory adjustments or scraps.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move.uom_id: Unit of measure of the demanded quantity.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move.valuatio: Monetary value of the move, for stock valuation. Not filled in yet.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move_dependen: The move that must be completed first, e.g. the pick in a pick-then-ship flow.
The move that waits until the predecessor is done.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move_line.bas: Quantity in the product's base unit.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move_line.des: The exact location the goods are put in.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move_line.lot: Lot or serial number of the goods. Empty when the goods are not tracked by lot.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move_line.mov: The move this line carries out. A move states how much is needed; its lines record what was actually taken and from where.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move_line.ope: When the line was carried out. Empty while it is only a reservation.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move_line.own: Owner of the goods when they do not belong to the company, e.g. consignment stock.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move_line.pac: Package the goods are taken from.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move_line.pic: Whether the goods on this line have been physically picked.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move_line.qua: Quantity reserved by this line, and moved when the transfer is validated.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move_line.res: Package the goods end up in, when they are repacked.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move_line.sou: The exact location the goods are taken from.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move_line.tra: The transfer of the move. Empty for moves made by the system.
field_desc.inventory_stock_move_line.uom: Unit of measure of the quantity.
field_desc.inventory_stock_operation_typ:
What happens to the unprocessed quantity when a transfer is only partly validated.
* Ask each time: ask the user whether to create a backorder
* Always create a backorder: always create a backorder for the remainder
* Cancel the remainder: never create a backorder; the remainder is cancelled
Destination location proposed for new transfers of this type.
Source location proposed for new transfers of this type.

Direction of the transfers of this type. It cannot be changed.
* Receipt: goods received into the warehouse
* Delivery: goods shipped out of the warehouse
* Internal transfer: goods moved between the company's own locations

When stock is reserved for transfers of this type.
* At confirmation: as soon as the transfer is confirmed
* Manually: only when a user reserves it
* Before the scheduled date: a set number of days before the scheduled date
How many days before the scheduled date stock is reserved, when the reservation method is before_scheduled_date.

When a transfer of this type can be processed.
* As soon as possible: goods are processed as soon as some are available
* All products at once: goods are processed only when all of them are available
field_desc.inventory_stock_product_confi: Unit the product's stock is counted and stored in.
The product this stock setting applies to; every variant of the product follows it.
field_desc.inventory_stock_quant.availab: Quantity on hand minus quantity reserved.
field_desc.inventory_stock_quant.base_uo: Unit the quantities are expressed in: the product's base unit.
field_desc.inventory_stock_quant.count_a: The person assigned to count this stock.
field_desc.inventory_stock_quant.count_q: Whether a count has been entered and is waiting to be applied.
field_desc.inventory_stock_quant.count_r: Code of the reason for the stock adjustment.
field_desc.inventory_stock_quant.count_s: On-hand quantity when the count was entered. If stock has moved since, the count must be entered again.
field_desc.inventory_stock_quant.counted: Quantity found by a stock count. It changes the on-hand quantity only when the adjustment is applied.
field_desc.inventory_stock_quant.incomin: When the stock arrived in the location, used by removal strategies such as FIFO.
field_desc.inventory_stock_quant.last_co: When this stock was last counted.
field_desc.inventory_stock_quant.lot_ref: Lot or serial number of the goods. Empty when the goods are not tracked by lot.
field_desc.inventory_stock_quant.next_co: When this stock is next due to be counted.
field_desc.inventory_stock_quant.on_hand: Quantity physically present. It changes only through completed stock moves, and can be negative after an oversell.
field_desc.inventory_stock_quant.owner_r: Owner of the goods when they do not belong to the company, e.g. consignment stock.
field_desc.inventory_stock_quant.product: The product variant this stock balance is for.
field_desc.inventory_stock_quant.reserve: Quantity promised to outgoing moves but not moved yet.
field_desc.inventory_stock_reservation.b: Unit of all quantities on this reservation: the product's base unit.
field_desc.inventory_stock_reservation.c: Quantity that has actually left stock against this reservation.
field_desc.inventory_stock_reservation.e: Quantity this reservation actually holds right now; zero once it is consumed, released or expired. This is what is deducted from available stock.

The reservation's current status, taking its expiry time into account.
* Active: the stock is still held
* Consumed: the whole quantity has left stock
* Released: the remaining quantity was given back
* Expired: the hold time has passed, so the stock is no longer held
When the system recorded the expiry, which can be later than the expiry time itself.
field_desc.inventory_stock_reservation.i: Key of the request that created this reservation, so a repeated request does not hold stock twice.
field_desc.inventory_stock_reservation.q: Quantity held when the reservation was made. It never changes; what is used or given back is shown separately.
field_desc.inventory_stock_reservation.r: Why the remaining quantity was given back, or expired when the hold time ran out.
When the remaining quantity was given back. For an expired reservation, this is the expiry time.
Quantity given back to stock, by a release or because the reservation expired.
Quantity still held: the reserved quantity minus what was consumed and released.
Fingerprint of the original request, used to detect a different request sent with the same key.
When the hold ends automatically. Empty means it does not expire.
field_desc.inventory_stock_reservation.s: Reference of the document that requested the reservation, in the requesting module.
The line of the requesting document this reservation is for.
The module that requested the reservation, such as sales.
Version of the requesting document. A new version is used when it is reserved again, e.g. after the first hold expired.
The kind of request within that module, such as a sales order fulfillment.
field_desc.inventory_stock_reservation.w: The warehouse whose stock is held. The exact shelf or slot is chosen later, when the goods are picked.
field_desc.inventory_stock_scrap.base_uo: Unit of the scrapped quantity: the product's base unit.
field_desc.inventory_stock_scrap.lot_ref: Lot or serial number of the goods. Empty when the goods are not tracked by lot.
field_desc.inventory_stock_scrap.move_id: The stock move created when the scrap was done.
field_desc.inventory_stock_scrap.origin_: The document that led to this scrap, such as an order number.
field_desc.inventory_stock_scrap.owner_r: Owner of the goods when they do not belong to the company, e.g. consignment stock.
field_desc.inventory_stock_scrap.package: Package the goods are taken from.
field_desc.inventory_stock_scrap.quantit: Quantity to scrap; must be greater than zero.
field_desc.inventory_stock_scrap.reason: Explanation of why the goods are scrapped.
field_desc.inventory_stock_scrap.reason_: Short code of the reason for the scrap.
field_desc.inventory_stock_scrap.scrap_l: Scrap location the goods go to. Goods there no longer count as available stock.
field_desc.inventory_stock_scrap.scrap_n: Document number of the scrap, generated automatically. It cannot be changed.
field_desc.inventory_stock_scrap.source_: Where the goods are scrapped from. It must hold enough stock.
field_desc.inventory_stock_scrap.transfe: The transfer during which the damage was found, if any.
field_desc.inventory_stock_transfer.back: The transfer whose remaining quantity this backorder carries.

What happens to the unprocessed quantity when the transfer is only partly validated, copied from the operation type.
* Ask each time: ask the user whether to create a backorder
* Always create a backorder: always create a backorder for the remainder
* Cancel the remainder: never create a backorder; the remainder is cancelled
field_desc.inventory_stock_transfer.chai: Groups the transfers of a multi-step flow, such as pick, pack and ship.
field_desc.inventory_stock_transfer.dead: Latest time by which the transfer should be done.
field_desc.inventory_stock_transfer.dest: Where the goods are moved to.
field_desc.inventory_stock_transfer.expi: When the stock held by this transfer is released automatically. Empty means it does not expire.
field_desc.inventory_stock_transfer.idem: Key of the validation that completed this transfer, so a repeated validation does not move stock twice.
field_desc.inventory_stock_transfer.oper:
Direction of the transfer, copied from the operation type when the transfer is created.
* Receipt: goods received into the warehouse
* Delivery: goods shipped out of the warehouse
* Internal transfer: goods moved between the company's own locations
The operation type that sets the transfer's direction and default settings.
field_desc.inventory_stock_transfer.orig: The document that caused this transfer, such as a purchase or sales order number.
field_desc.inventory_stock_transfer.prio: Higher values are handled first when stock is scarce.
field_desc.inventory_stock_transfer.rese:
When stock is reserved for this transfer, copied from the operation type when created.
* At confirmation: as soon as the transfer is confirmed
* Manually: only when a user reserves it
* Before the scheduled date: a set number of days before the scheduled date
field_desc.inventory_stock_transfer.sche: When the transfer is planned to happen.
field_desc.inventory_stock_transfer.ship:
When the transfer can be processed, copied from the operation type.
* As soon as possible: goods are processed as soon as some are available
* All products at once: goods are processed only when all of them are available
field_desc.inventory_stock_transfer.sour: Reference of the request this transfer serves, in the requesting module.
Where the goods are moved from.
The kind of request this transfer serves, such as sales_fulfillment.
field_desc.inventory_stock_transfer.tran: Document number of the transfer, generated automatically from the operation type. It cannot be changed.
field_desc.inventory_storage_category.al:
Whether incoming goods can be put in a location that already holds goods.
* Allow mixing: always allowed
* Same product only: only goods of the same product
* Only when empty: only when the location is empty
field_desc.inventory_storage_category.ma: Maximum weight a location of this category can hold. Empty means unlimited.
field_desc.inventory_warehouse.incoming_:
How many steps goods go through when received. Changing it does not affect receipts already in progress.
* Receive and store (1 step): received directly into stock
* Receive then store (2 steps): received into the input area, then moved to stock
* Receive, inspect then store (3 steps): received into the input area, checked in quality control, then moved to stock
field_desc.inventory_warehouse.manager_u: The person responsible for the warehouse.
field_desc.inventory_warehouse.outgoing_:
How many steps goods go through when shipped. Changing it does not affect deliveries already in progress.
* Deliver directly (1 step): shipped directly from stock
* Pick then deliver (2 steps): moved to the output area, then shipped
* Pick, pack then deliver (3 steps): packed in the packing area, moved to the output area, then shipped
field_desc.inventory_warehouse.output_lo: Where goods wait to be shipped (Output), used by the two- and three-step outgoing flows. Created when a flow first needs it, archived when the flow no longer uses it and unarchived when it is used again.
field_desc.inventory_warehouse.packing_l: Where goods are packed before they are moved to the output area, used by the three-step outgoing flow. Created when the flow first needs it, archived when the flow no longer uses it and unarchived when it is used again.
field_desc.inventory_warehouse.quality_l: Where received goods wait for quality control before they are stored, used by the three-step incoming flow. Created when the flow first needs it, archived when the flow no longer uses it and unarchived when it is used again.
field_desc.inventory_warehouse.receiving: Where incoming goods are first received (Input), used by the two- and three-step incoming flows. Created when a flow first needs it, archived when the flow no longer uses it and unarchived when it is used again.
field_desc.inventory_warehouse.root_loca: The warehouse's root location: a group location named after the warehouse code, under which all its locations sit. It holds no stock. It is created together with the warehouse and archived or deleted with it.
field_desc.inventory_warehouse.stock_loc: The location named Stock under the root, where the warehouse's goods are kept. It is created together with the warehouse and archived or deleted with it.
field_desc.inventory_warehouse.warehouse:
The warehouse's role in the organization. It is used only for reporting and selection lists.
* Central: a main warehouse that supplies others
* Regional: a secondary warehouse
* Point of sale: a warehouse serving a point of sale
* Other: any other role
field_desc.inventory_warehouse_product_g: The product variant of the warehouse and product pair this record protects.
The warehouse of the warehouse and product pair this record protects from conflicting simultaneous stock changes.
field_desc.inventory_warehouse_supply_re: The warehouse being resupplied. It must differ from the source warehouse.
The source warehouse used when nothing else decides. Only one per destination warehouse.
Order in which source warehouses are tried; lower numbers first.
The warehouse that may resupply the destination warehouse. This only allows the route; it moves no stock.
